summary: Suno Free is $0/month with 50 credits per day, access to free models (currently v6-mini), standard features, and four concurrent generations in a shared queue. Free includes no commercial rights, no monthly song downloads, no add-on credit purchases and no stem separation. Credits do not carry over day to day. Uploads of up to eight minutes are listed. No fixed program end date is published. No account or actual generation/download was tested.
claim_steps: Click Sign Up and create a free Suno account.
Use the Free Plan — 50 credits renew daily. Stay within the free model/features and shared queue; no commercial rights, monthly song downloads, add-on credits or stem separation are included.
